description: Focused SOC investigation for enforced and observe-mode blocked hook decisions: canonical verdicts, all exported rule IDs, safe projected tool context, repeated signatures, affected agents, and correlation pivots.

panels.title: Enforced blocks
panels.description: Final hook decisions actually returned as block.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced="true" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Would-block decisions
panels.description: Observe-mode or unsupported-surface decisions that were not enforced.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block="true" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Blocked prompt hooks
panels.description: Blocked prompt-submission surfaces. Prompt text is not copied into decision records.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"(?i)userpromptsubmit|beforesubmitprompt|pre_user_prompt|userpromptsubmitted|user_prompt_submit|prompt" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Blocked tool hooks
panels.description: Blocked non-prompt hook surfaces. See projected blocked tool calls below.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event!~"(?i)userpromptsubmit|beforesubmitprompt|pre_user_prompt|userpromptsubmitted|user_prompt_submit|prompt" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Affected agents
panels.description: Distinct reported agent IDs. Missing identity is not invented.

targets.expr: count(sum by (agent_id) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | body_gen_ai_agent_id!="" | label_format agent_id="{{.body_gen_ai_agent_id}}" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Primary rules
panels.description: Distinct first-listed rule IDs. Detail shows all eight possible rule slots.

targets.expr: count(sum by (rule_id) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | regexp "(?s).*\\\"defenseclaw.guardrail.rule_ids\\\":\\[\\\"(?P<rule_id>[^\\\"]+)\\\".*" [$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Blocked decisions over time
panels.description: Enforced and would-block decisions remain separate.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced="true" [$__interval])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block="true" [$__interval])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Top primary rules
panels.description: First verdict rule ID on attributed decisions. Decisions without exported rule IDs remain in the overview and raw log details.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (rule_id) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | regexp "(?s).*\\\"defenseclaw.guardrail.rule_ids\\\":\\[\\\"(?P<rule_id>[^\\\"]+)\\\".*" [$__range])))

panels.title: Similar block signatures
panels.description: Exact grouping of attributed decisions by connector, decision, hook, severity, target/app, and primary rule—not semantic or AI-generated similarity. Unattributed decisions remain in the overview and raw log details.

targets.expr: topk(50, sum by (connector, decision, hook_event, severity, target, primary_rule) (count_over_time({service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | regexp "(?s).*\\\"defenseclaw.guardrail.rule_ids\\\":\\[\\\"(?P<primary_rule>[^\\\"]+)\\\".*" | label_format hook_event="{{if .body_defenseclaw_hook_event}}{{.body_defenseclaw_hook_event}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", severity="{{if .body_defenseclaw_security_severity}}{{.body_defenseclaw_security_severity}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}", target="{{if .body_defenseclaw_destination_app}}{{.body_defenseclaw_destination_app}}{{else}}unreported{{end}}" [$__range])))

panels.title: Blocked event records — rules, reason, agent, and correlation
panels.description: Canonical hook decisions. Rules are verdict-ordered. Reason and target follow post-redaction projection. Expand for all fields; pivot by agent/evaluation/operation/trace without treating adjacency as causality.

targets.expr: {service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | regexp "(?s).*\\\"defenseclaw.guardrail.rule_ids\\\":\\[(?P<rule_ids>[^]]*)\\].*" | line_format "{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}ENFORCED{{else}}WOULD BLOCK{{end}} · {{.connector}} · {{.body_defenseclaw_hook_event}} · {{.body_defenseclaw_security_severity}} · agent={{if .body_gen_ai_agent_name}}{{.body_gen_ai_agent_name}}{{else}}{{.body_gen_ai_agent_id}}{{end}} · target={{.body_defenseclaw_destination_app}} · rules={{.rule_ids}} · reason={{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_reason}} · evaluation={{.body_defenseclaw_evaluation_id}} · operation={{.body_defenseclaw_operation_id}} · trace_id={{.correlation_trace_id}}"

panels.title: Projected blocked tool calls
panels.description: Canonical tool.invocation.blocked records. Arguments are already projected for this destination and reflect its redaction profile; this panel never reverses redaction.

targets.expr: {service_name="defenseclaw"} | json | __error__="" | event_name="tool.invocation.blocked" | connector=~"$connector" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | line_format "{{.connector}} · agent={{if .body_gen_ai_agent_name}}{{.body_gen_ai_agent_name}}{{else}}{{.body_gen_ai_agent_id}}{{end}} · tool={{.body_gen_ai_tool_name}} · args={{.body_gen_ai_tool_call_arguments}} · content_state={{.body_defenseclaw_content_input_state}} · call={{.body_gen_ai_tool_call_id}} · operation={{.body_defenseclaw_operation_id}} · trace_id={{.correlation_trace_id}}"

panels.title: Prompt-surface decisions
panels.description: Blocked prompt decisions with rules and post-redaction reason. Prompt bodies are not duplicated here; use Agent360 when the route permits projected content.

targets.expr: {service_name="defenseclaw"} |~ "$rule_id" | json | __error__="" | event_name="hook_decision" | connector=~"$connector" | body_defenseclaw_security_severity=~"$severity" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"$hook_event" | body_gen_ai_agent_id=~"$agent" | label_format decision="{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}enforced{{else if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_would_block \"true\"}}would_block{{else}}other{{end}}" | decision=~"$decision" | body_defenseclaw_hook_event=~"(?i)userpromptsubmit|beforesubmitprompt|pre_user_prompt|userpromptsubmitted|user_prompt_submit|prompt" | regexp "(?s).*\\\"defenseclaw.guardrail.rule_ids\\\":\\[(?P<rule_ids>[^]]*)\\].*" | line_format "{{if eq .body_defenseclaw_guardrail_enforced \"true\"}}ENFORCED{{else}}WOULD BLOCK{{end}} · {{.connector}} · agent={{if .body_gen_ai_agent_name}}{{.body_gen_ai_agent_name}}{{else}}{{.body_gen_ai_agent_id}}{{end}} · rules={{.rule_ids}} · reason={{.body_defenseclaw_guardrail_reason}} · evaluation={{.body_defenseclaw_evaluation_id}} · operation={{.body_defenseclaw_operation_id}} · trace_id={{.correlation_trace_id}}"

options.content:
### Investigate a block

1. Filter by connector, decision, severity, hook surface, rule, or agent ID.
2. Expand a decision and copy its agent, evaluation, operation, or trace ID.
3. Open Agent360 for chronology/recovery, Findings for rule recurrence, or Policy Decisions for fleet trends.

A verdict can carry eight rule IDs. “Similar” means the same telemetry signature, not semantic similarity. Missing content was not reported or was removed by destination redaction.
